This aged grog can be used to complete a [[Vintage Old Sully's Grog|special quest]] and earn you a great one time reward. After you complete [[The Collaborator]] quest in Korthos (the fourth quest in a series), talk to [[Merla Bauerdatter]] in the [[Wavecrest Tavern]] to begin. (This can only be done once per character.)
Among various other effects, this drink heals the imbiber 6 to 11 hit points. | notes = | Category1 = DDO Store potions‎ | Category2 = Healing potions }}
